Description: Forensic isolation security group - blocks all traffic

Tags.Value: Blocks all inbound and outbound traffic for forensic isolation

Notes.Purpose: Used to isolate compromised instances during incident response
Notes.OutboundRules: NONE - All outbound traffic blocked (default egress rule removed)
Notes.Usage: Applied to instances automatically by Lambda during incident response
BestPractices: Never attach to production instances manually
Document all instances using this security group
